name: four-color-asian-girl-chocolate-ad
image_purpose: chocolate campaign and social advertising grid

prompt.project_info: Create an ultra-realistic commercial fashion-style advertisement split into four vivid color panels with adult East Asian women and small chocolate pieces.
prompt.main_subject: Four adult East Asian women with original fictional identities: yellow panel with straight bangs and tied-back hair in a cream lace-detail blouse and yellow skirt; red panel with straight dark hair and bangs in a black top and red skirt; green panel with long wavy hair in a loose green dress and peace-sign gesture; blue panel with glasses and tied-back hair in a blue-and-white striped shirt. Each holds a small generic chocolate piece.
prompt.composition_elements: Four vertical panels with bold yellow, red, green, and blue backgrounds, matching silky flowing fabric textures, distinct pose and wardrobe per panel, confident or playful expressions, clean commercial composition.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Bright studio lighting with high contrast, crisp detail, glossy commercial finish, vibrant color separation, no packaging or branding.
prompt.technical_specs: Ultra-realistic commercial fashion photography, sharp focus, natural anatomy and skin texture, clean four-panel grid, no text, logos, branding, or watermark.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Ultra-realistic commercial fashion-style advertisement split into four vertical panels with bold yellow, red, green, and blue backgrounds, each featuring a different adult East Asian woman with an original fictional identity. Yellow panel: straight bangs and tied-back hair, cream lace-detail blouse and yellow skirt, slight smile, small chocolate piece near face. Red panel: straight dark hair and bangs, black top and red skirt, neutral confident expression, chocolate near chin. Green panel: long wavy hair, loose green dress, playful peace sign and smile, chocolate in hand. Blue panel: glasses and tied-back hair, blue-and-white striped shirt, calm expression, chocolate held with both hands. Soft flowing matching fabric textures, bright studio lighting, high contrast, crisp glossy commercial photography, clean composition without packaging or branding.
prompt.negative_prompt: minor or underage appearance, celebrity likeness, public figure likeness, explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, nudity, blurry, low quality, distorted anatomy, extra limbs, deformed hands, chocolate packaging, readable text, logo, watermark, signature, plastic skin, over-smooth, over-saturated, HDR look
